scientific_decisions.source_name: Bulk merge of all Erioneuron avenaceum names
scientific_decisions.reason: Reject bulk alias: E. avenaceum itself is separately accepted and its historical varieties map to more than one accepted species.

scientific_decisions.reason: Reject merger; E. nealleyi is separately accepted, including historical E. avenaceum var. nealleyi.

scientific_decisions.reason: Reject treating the invalidly published historical variety as an independently valid accepted taxon; POWO flags 'not validly publ. Not accepted by the author.' Do not equate with E. avenaceum var. pygmaeum.
